title: GS21 gvy25s at bv_comp 2.5: the level compensation strengthened as in BGN's bvychs30
question: Does strong level compensation on the mirrored ladder give GS21 bvychs30's cross-sectional interaction (type revealed by size x leverage/mix) and a gap?
notes:
WHY (2026-10-30). In BGN the compensation ladder on the sign-switching types gave gaps of +0.026 / +0.006 / +0.048 / +0.063 at bv_comp 1.2 / 1.8 / 2.5 / 3.0, with the type 98% visible in size and the premium monotone: a product of a visible mean-zero type with the project mix. gvy25s (bv_comp 1.2, gap -0.012) is the GS21 analogue at the weak setting; this continues it. gs_ashift = -bv_comp log W(b) was +-0.54/0.58 at 1.2, so about +-1.15 here (gvy25sh solved at +-0.9, gvy25sx2 at +-1.1; gvy25sx3's +-1.7 type did not converge).

PRECOMMITMENT STATUS: precommitted=false; ids filled from the Quest build log by the solve script before any seed runs.

PREDICTION (2026-10-30): room above gvy25s's 11%, gap +0.01 to +0.05; SR_max rises with the level spread. FALSIFIED if the gap is at or below gvy25s's on three seeds or the linear ceiling keeps more than 85% of SR_max.
